title: Open Qur’an Circle

title: Youth Islamic Studies
subtitle: For boys · Starts September 2026
alt: Youth Islamic Studies for boys: Fiqh, Aqida, Hadith, Qur’an, du’as, Arabic and Islamic character. Six terms over two years, Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 5–6.30pm, starting September 2026. £300 per year.

title: The Seeker’s Gateway
